# Security Policy

## Scope

This repository contains a public portfolio case study and a static GitHub Pages presentation. It intentionally contains no production secrets, no real infrastructure identifiers and no deployment configuration.

## Reporting Sensitive Findings

If you believe a sensitive value is present, do not post it publicly. Report only the affected filename and category of concern to the repository owner through a private channel selected by the owner.

## Security Boundaries

- Architecture content is generalized.
- Example concepts require independent security review before real use.
- Scripts in this repository validate the portfolio itself and do not modify servers.
- This repository is not production deployment guidance.
